annotation_notes: Person rises immediately, walks toward chair, turns and sits. Short initial seated baseline may challenge event detection. Walking includes turning steps; boundary near 7.5s is approximate.
annotator: Codex visual inspection of original-video contact sheets
review_method: 20 overview frames per clip; additional 0.25s or 0.5s samples around selected transitions. Not exhaustive frame-by-frame playback.
event_definition: Draft support-based definition: exit when pelvis leaves bed support during a completed rise; return when seated/lying support is re-established. Human must reconcile this with assignment event policy; proximity alone does not suppress exit.
